scope: symbolic coordinate templates underlying the passage-level C8/C16(m=2) conflict catalogs -- does the compression trend continue when quotiented by translation/reflection symmetry

headline.c8_same_mode_status: PROVED complete (exact set equality with the union of realized same-mode abstract templates across all three corrected j=4 catalogs)
headline.c8_crossing_templates_do_not_collapse: 49/53/191 distinct crossing (anchor-junction) templates per instance, union 206, only partial pairwise overlap (21-48 shared) -- a genuine negative result
headline.c16_m2_same_mode_status: PROVED complete (21/22 realized in the single available (4,55,7) instance; realized subset of derived is exact -- soundness confirmed, the missing 1 is data sparsity not incompleteness)
headline.c16_m2_crossing_templates_do_not_collaps: 3248 distinct crossing templates for 27,629 of 32,921 clauses (84% of the catalog) -- dominant and non-collapsing
headline.conclusion: The 'bulk'/'same-mode' fraction of both catalogs (11233/13877=81% for C8, 5292/32921=16% for C16 m=2) collapses beautifully to a handful of universal, j-independent symbolic templates, derived from first principles (not just clustered) and cross-validated by literal construction+cycle-closure verification at fresh j=4 and j=5 coordinates. The 'crossing'/junction fraction (dominant for C16 m=2: 84% of clauses) does NOT collapse -- hundreds to thousands of instance-specific templates, a real negative result. Net assessment: a full all-j proof via template counting is NOT plausible for the junction-heavy part of the catalog without much harder per-anchor case analysis; the same-mode fraction alone is a promising, well-supported partial result but does not by itself close the family.

corrected_catalog_note.description: This analysis uses the CORRECTED catalogs (commit 8617422, 'Exclude structurally-vacuous two-p3-passage supports'): a completed graph selects exactly one linked-pair gadget ever, hence exactly one hub_L-hub_R joining edge, so two DIFFERENT p3 passages can never coexist in one simple cycle (both would need to traverse that single edge). This removes the route1==route2==3 case from the template derivation (encoded directly in enumerate_bulk_shapes/enumerate_same_mode_abstract_shapes in type_t_port_passage_templates.py). Corrected clause counts: C8 4218/4227/5432 (was 5007/5044/6359) for (4,55,7)/(4,2,2)/(4,28,4); C16 m=2 32921 (was 40833) for (4,55,7).

phase0_coordinate_audit.claims: Every core vertex label parses uniquely to (anchor) or (path, index); symbolic_adjacent(u,v) (same path, index differing by 1) reproduces materialized bare-core adjacency EXACTLY, checked exhaustively (all O(n^2) pairs, not sampled) on all three j=4 catalog instances plus one j=5 instance. distance_to_nearest_anchor matches true BFS graph distance, exhaustively checked on the same 4 instances. The 13-anchor/19-path SKELETON TOPOLOGY (which anchor connects to which via which named path) is proved identical for every legal (j,a,c) -- only 4 of the 19 path-length formulas (A_left=a-1, A_right=4Y-8-a, C_left=c-1, C_right=Y-8-c) depend on Y/a/c; the other 15 are fixed integer constants.

phase1_symbolic_features.claims: Every C8/C16(m=2) conflict's witness cycle decodes (via split_witness/decode_m2_witness, generalized to decode_general_witness for future m>2) into alternating hub-passage and bare-core-path segments; each segment's branch/family/offset/distance-to-anchor/same-vs-cross-path classification computed via type_t_port_coordinates. Bulk criterion (BULK_THRESHOLD=12, matching the proved C16 total-core-path-length<=12 bound) formalized as: core path stays on one named path (no anchor crossing) AND all 4 passage endpoints have distance>12 from every anchor.

phase2_quotient_c8.shared_vs_instance_specific: The 6 same-mode abstract templates are IDENTICAL (literal set equality) across all three instances. Crossing templates overlap only partially: |T1&T2|=21/49&53, |T1&T3|=39/49&191, |T2&T3|=48/53&191, union=206.

phase3_first_principles.derivation: enumerate_same_mode_abstract_shapes(8) exhaustively cases route1,route2 in {2,3} (excluding route1=route2=3), l1,l2>=1 summing to 8-route1-route2, x2 branch arrangements (same/cross), quotiented by the identical canonicalize_cyclic symmetry used on real data. Yields exactly 6 templates.
phase3_first_principles.completeness_check: set(derived) == union(realized same-mode abstract keys across all 3 corrected j=4 catalogs) -- literal Python set equality, TRUE.
phase3_first_principles.genuineness_check: Every one of the 6 templates independently re-instantiated (instantiate_same_branch/instantiate_cross_branch) at FRESH, previously-unused coordinates in both a j=4 instance (55,7) and a j=5 instance (64,16), and verified via materialize_passages+edge_path_cycle (the project's own trusted minimal-materialization method) to close a genuine 8-cycle in every case (64/64 checks passed after adjusting for branch-length availability).

phase4_c16_m2.status: PROVED (derivation+soundness on available data) / COMPUTATIONALLY_CERTIFIED_PARTIAL (single instance, m=2 stage only)
phase4_c16_m2.derivation: enumerate_same_mode_abstract_shapes(16) yields 22 templates; 21/22 realized in the one available instance (realized is a strict subset of derived -- SOUND, the missing one is data sparsity).

phase5_incremental_ingestion.claims: General-m infrastructure for future C16 m=3,4,5 ingestion, built so the vertex-tag/core-path-descriptor/canonicalization machinery is reused unmodified (only the witness-decoder and symmetry-group order change with m). self_test_general_m2_matches_specialized reproduces the specialized m=2 pipeline's raw_key and abstract_key EXACTLY on all 4 corrected real catalogs (5007+... no: 4218+4227+5432+32921=46,798 total conflicts, 0 mismatches).

phase6_lifting.restriction_claim: PROVED by construction: enumerate_same_mode_abstract_shapes(L) takes only L as input, never j/a/c, so the same-mode abstract template SET for a fixed target length is identical for every instance -- a j>=5 catalog's same-mode conflicts can only ever land on keys from this fixed finite set.
phase6_lifting.embedding_threshold_derivation: A_left+A_right=4Y-9 and C_left+C_right=Y-9 for EVERY valid (j,a) resp. (j,c) (only the split varies with a/c, not the total -- PROVED, checked at j=4,5,6). Same-branch worst-case shape needs a branch of length >= 27+(L-4) to be BULK-classified (translation-free, distance>12 from every anchor); solving ceil(budget/2)>=that bound gives the minimal j guaranteeing EVERY valid a/c admits the full bulk-classified same-branch set: j>=5 for the A-family (both C8 and C16 m=2), j>=7 for the C-family (both lengths) -- the C-family threshold is later because its total growing budget (Y-9) is 4x smaller than the A-family's (4Y-9) at the same j.
phase6_lifting.weak_existence_note: A separate, much weaker threshold governs whether the same-mode template merely EXISTS at all (not necessarily bulk-classified): this needs only length>=l1+l2+3, satisfied even at j=4 for most (j,a,c) -- explaining why the SAME 6/22 same-mode template sets were already found complete even in the (28,4) instance, whose growing branches never reach the deep-bulk (>12) regime.
phase6_lifting.scope_clarification: This proves the SAME finite conflict-clause template set continues to arise as valid, sound constraints for j meeting the threshold -- a structural fact about which clauses exist. It does NOT prove (and does not need to prove) that the overall exact-cover SAT instance is forced UNSAT for large j; that is a distinct, harder, global combinatorial question (raised externally re: a finite-horizon random-partition/Lovasz-Local-Lemma completion-existence lemma) not addressed here and not in conflict with this result.

phase7_9_transfer_automaton.note: Stretch goal per the task; not reached given the time invested in Phases 0-6. Starting point: state = (unfinished same-mode/crossing passage obligations within distance 12 of the current cut along the anchor skeleton), transitions = the 19 named paths with their length formulas (15 fixed, 4 growing), acceptance = a full valid exact-cover of one branch's deficient vertices reached with no open same-mode conflict spanning the cut. The Phase 0 coordinate module and Phase 2-4 template catalogs are the direct inputs this would consume.
